capabilities: publish the current note to a Moon server instance
unpublish a note from the Moon server instance
store the server-assigned ID as a note property
configure the server base URL, API key and API secret
extras: The README does not explain what a Moon server is or link to its documentation; API key and secret are described as optional.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push individual notes to a self-hosted Moon server instance.
summary: Publishing plugin that sends notes to a Moon server instance and tracks the returned ID as a note property.
